I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats.

- **Where the figure comes from:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes it.
- **Not confirmed by a document:** none of the files Dana can see has a signed renewal, so I couldn't check the figure against one. I told her to ask Ilse if the tracker needs a document to back it up.
- **Old numbers ignored:** the 180 and 185 seat counts in the channel are from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, not this renewal. I didn't use them.

Seat counts are account details, not money terms, and Dana is on the North team, so no approval was needed. I only used #north-team, which she belongs to, and files she can see.
